title: My mall world is always in the middle east somewhere
content: It's in middle of a desert and it's a huge massive building made out of like a mountain or a huge rock. And there tons of people gathered hanging out and laying around on all the floors. And theres a section where the bathroom is and it has hundreds of stalls . Then something huge is coming and I got to try to hide so I always run down into a bottom door and go down this massive stairwell to get downstairs to hide. Iv had this dream so many times.
